name: Mutual Mine Campground, Withlacoochee State Forest (Citrus Tract)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A small primitive campground in the Mutual Mine Recreation Area of the 50,000-acre Citrus Tract south of Inverness, reservable year-round through ReserveAmerica. It is the cheapest paid fallback for the Crystal River and Homosassa nights. The map point is OpenStreetMap's 'Mutual Mine' quarry feature that the recreation area is named for.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in any 30-day period on Florida Forest Service lands The Citrus Tract is a wildlife management area with fall hunts; the 2026-27 Citrus dates were not obtained. Developed campgrounds stay open year-round; wear orange on trails. The forest's hunt camps are a separate thing: $50 or $100 seasonal permits that require a hunting licence.
